resources.string: Bluetooth LE Peripheral is not supported on this device. The app will exit.
Hold to put the Kindle to sleep
Battery level shown on the Kindle: %1$d%%

Waiting for the Kindle: it connects when it is awake. If it doesn\'t within a few seconds, connect the remote from the Kindle\'s Bluetooth devices. To pair, on the Kindle open Settings › Wi-Fi and Bluetooth › Bluetooth devices.
The Kindle is still connected from before the remote restarted, and ignores it until it reconnects. On the Kindle, turn Bluetooth off and on, or disconnect and reconnect the remote.

Kindle connected, but the remote\'s Bluetooth layout changed since the Kindle last set it up, so keys may do nothing. On the Kindle, disconnect and reconnect the remote, or put the Kindle to sleep and wake it.
This phone placed the remote where a Kindle can\'t use it. Turn the phone\'s Bluetooth off and on.
Bluetooth is off. The remote starts again when it\'s back on.
Kindle connected. The volume keys turn pages too, even with the screen off.
